papers.title: Ultralow p-type contact resistance for ultra-nanoscaled 2D-materials transistors
papers.summary: High contact resistance is one of the main bottlenecks for practical two-dimensional (2D) materials transistors, especially for p-type transistors and future 2D ultra-nanoscaled (sub-10 nm) FETs (PMOS + CMOS). We develop self-consistent contact resistance models for metal-2D semiconductor-metal devices to capture the essential interface physics for both vertical and edge configurations. Our calculations have been verified with various recent experiments of p-type and n-type contacts. For a given set of materials, the model determines the scaling of contact resistance over a wide range of device parameters including channel length (100s nm down to sub-10 nm), doping and mobility of the 2D materials, contact length of the electrodes, and applied voltages. These results identify the key factors in order to reduce the contact resistance for p-type 2D semiconductor WSe$_2$ towards the sub-10 nm channel length scale that are readily to be realized by future experiments. It is found that the effect of source-limited current saturation is the key challenge for down scaling 2D FET to sub-10 nm channel length. Two topological semi-metals as potential electrodes are proposed for 2D p-type semiconducting WSe$_2$ with our predicted contact resistance $R_c<$ 100 $Ω\; {\rm μm}$ approaching the quantum limit. Our model is also verified with the computational expensive full quantum atomistic model that is currently limited to a few nm scale.
papers.abstract_cn: 高接触电阻是二维（2D）材料晶体管实现实际应用的主要瓶颈之一，尤其对于p型晶体管以及未来的二维超纳米尺度（亚10 nm）FET（PMOS + CMOS）而言更是如此。我们针对金属-二维半导体-金属器件建立了自洽的接触电阻模型，以描述垂直结构和边缘结构中的关键界面物理。我们的计算结果已通过近期多项p型和n型接触实验得到验证。对于给定的一组材料，该模型能够确定接触电阻随多种器件参数变化的规律，这些参数包括沟道长度（从数百纳米缩短至亚10 nm）、二维材料的掺杂浓度和迁移率、电极的接触长度以及外加电压。研究结果确定了降低p型二维半导体WSe$_2$接触电阻的关键因素，从而推动其向亚10 nm沟道长度尺度缩放；这一尺度有望通过未来实验较为容易地实现。研究发现，源极受限的电流饱和效应是将二维FET缩放至亚10 nm沟道长度所面临的关键挑战。我们为二维p型半导体WSe$_2$提出了两种可用作电极的拓扑半金属，并预测其接触电阻R_c<100 Ω·μm，接近量子极限。我们的模型还通过计算成本较高的全量子原子模型进行了验证，而后者目前仅适用于数纳米尺度。

papers.title: Monolithically integrating polarization-doped InGaN p-FET and GaN n-FET for complementary logic circuitry
papers.summary: Low-efficiency p-type impurity doping has long impeded the practical adoption of wide-bandgap semiconductors in integrated circuits (ICs). In wide-bandgap III-nitride semiconductors, the inherent polarization effects provide an alternative approach to engineering electrical properties. Here, we report the monolithic integration of polarization-doped InGaN p-channel FETs with polarization-doped GaN n-channel FETs for complementary logic (CL) circuitry. The enhancement-mode (E-mode) InGaN p-FET achieves a high current density exceeding 20 mA/mm. We construct a series of III-nitride CL building blocks, including inverter, ring oscillator (RO), NAND, NOR, RS latch, and 6T-SRAM. The inverter exhibits a high maximum voltage gain of 154.1 V/V, and the RO achieves a record short propagation delay per stage of 10.4 ns. Additionally, we demonstrate the monolithic integration of CL buffers with high-voltage GaN power transistors. These results establish the polarization-doped III-nitride CL platform as a promising solution for high-frequency power management ICs and harsh-environment electronics.
papers.abstract_cn: 低效率的p型杂质掺杂长期以来阻碍了宽禁带半导体在集成电路（IC）中的实际应用。在宽禁带III族氮化物半导体中，固有的极化效应为调控电学性质提供了一种替代途径。在此，我们报道了将极化掺杂InGaN p沟道FET与极化掺杂GaN n沟道FET单片集成，用于构建互补逻辑（CL）电路。增强型（E-mode）InGaN p-FET实现了超过20 mA/mm的高电流密度。我们构建了一系列III族氮化物CL功能模块，包括反相器、环形振荡器（RO）、NAND、NOR、RS锁存器和6T-SRAM。反相器表现出154.1 V/V的高最大电压增益，RO实现了每级10.4 ns的创纪录短传播延迟。此外，我们还展示了CL缓冲器与高压GaN功率晶体管的单片集成。这些结果表明，极化掺杂III族氮化物CL平台有望成为高频电源管理IC和恶劣环境电子器件的解决方案。

papers.title: Epitaxial SiGeSn alloys for CMOS-compatible thermoelectric devices
papers.summary: The integration of thermoelectric devices into mainstream microelectronic technological platform could be a major breakthrough in various fields within the \emph{so-called} Green-IT realm. In this article, the thermoelectric properties of heteroepitaxial SiGeSn alloys, a novel CMOS compatible material system, are evaluated to assess their possible application in thermoelectric devices. To this purpose, starting from the experimentally low lattice thermal conductivity of SiGeSn/Ge/Si layers of about $\sim$1-2 W/m$\cdot$K assessed by means of 3-$ω$ measurements, the figure of merits are calculated through the use of Boltzmann transport equation, taking into account the relevant inter-valley scattering processes, peculiar of this multi-valley material system. Values for the figure of merit $ZT$ exceeding $1$ have been obtained for both p- and n- type material at operating temperatures within the 300---400 K range, i.e. at a typical On-Chip temperatures. In this interval, the predicted power factor also features very competitive values of the order of 20 $\rm{μW/cm\cdot K^2}$. Our finding indicates that this new class of Si-based materials has extremely good prospects for real-world applications, and can further stimulate scientific investigation in this ambit.
papers.abstract_cn: 将热电器件集成到主流微电子技术平台中，可能成为所谓绿色信息技术（Green-IT）领域多个方向的重大突破。本文评估了异质外延SiGeSn合金的热电性质，以考察这一新型CMOS兼容材料体系在热电器件中的潜在应用。为此，首先基于通过3-ω测量确定的SiGeSn/Ge/Si层较低实验晶格热导率（约为1-2 W/m·K），利用玻尔兹曼输运方程计算热电优值，并考虑了这一多谷材料体系中特有的相关谷间散射过程。在300---400 K的工作温度范围内，即典型的片上温度范围内，p型和n型材料的热电优值ZT均获得了超过1的数值。在该温区内，预测的功率因子也表现出极具竞争力的数值，约为20 μW/cm·K^2。我们的研究结果表明，这类新型硅基材料具有极佳的实际应用前景，并可进一步推动该领域的科学研究。

papers.title: Self-Focusing Control for Depth-Precise Wafer Slicing of 4H-SiC in Femtosecond Laser Processing
papers.summary: 4H-SiC has emerged as a third-generation chip material because its superior thermal conductivity and high breakdown field enable the material to achieve high power density and higher switching frequencies in power-electronics applications. As chip architectures evolve toward 3D and heterogeneous integration, the mechanical and thermal design space tightens while yield risks grow. In particular, advanced packages require mid-process wafer thinning to < 100 $μ$m to shorten interconnects and control thermo-mechanical stress. Femtosecond laser slicing for 4H-SiC wafers offers a non-contact processing approach to produce thin layers with low defects, while strong optical nonlinearities obscure the relationship between the laser parameters and the resulting slicing quality. Here, we systematically investigate Kerr-induced self-focusing using a femtosecond laser in 4H-SiC slicing by combining experiments, a semi-empirical analytical model, and numerical ray optics simulations. We demonstrate that the interplay between pulse energy and processing depth governs the self-focusing behavior, which directly correlates with post-separation surface texture parameters and separation stress, thereby linking nonlinear beam propagation to slicing quality. Based on this relationship, we define a processability map in the pulse energy with self-focusing depth space over a normalized irradiance background. Analytically, the model extends the Marburger formula to focused beams by replacing the power ratio with a normalized irradiance. Ray optics simulations capture the geometric features at the self-focusing point and are validated against experimental observations. Within physically defined thresholds, the processability map directly connects laser parameters to separation stress and surface texture metrics, providing practical guidance for depth control beyond trial-and-error.
papers.abstract_cn: 4H-SiC凭借优异的热导率和高击穿场，使器件能够在电力电子应用中实现高功率密度和更高开关频率，因此已成为第三代芯片材料。随着芯片架构向三维和异质集成发展，机械与热设计空间不断收紧，同时良率风险也随之增加。特别是，先进封装要求在中间工艺阶段将晶圆减薄至小于100 μm，以缩短互连长度并控制热机械应力。4H-SiC晶圆的飞秒激光切片提供了一种非接触式加工方法，能够以低缺陷制备薄层；然而，强光学非线性使激光参数与最终切片质量之间的关系难以明确。本文结合实验、半经验解析模型和数值光线光学仿真，系统研究了飞秒激光进行4H-SiC切片过程中的克尔效应诱导自聚焦。我们证明，脉冲能量与加工深度之间的相互作用决定了自聚焦行为，而自聚焦行为又与分离后的表面纹理参数和分离应力直接相关，从而建立了非线性光束传播与切片质量之间的联系。基于这一关系，我们在归一化辐照度背景下，以脉冲能量-自聚焦深度空间定义了可加工性图。通过将功率比替换为归一化辐照度，该解析模型将Marburger公式扩展到了聚焦光束情形。光线光学仿真捕捉到了自聚焦点处的几何特征，并通过实验观测结果进行了验证。在物理定义的阈值范围内，可加工性图能够直接将激光参数与分离应力和表面纹理指标关联起来，为超越试错法的深度控制提供实用指导。

papers.title: Controlling surface kinetics scales p-type two-dimensional semiconductors
papers.summary: Nature Materials, Published online: 10 August 2026; doi:10.1038/s41563-026-02704-5 The precise control of surface and near-surface atomic kinetics produces environmentally stable p-type two-dimensional (2D) semiconductors at wafer scale, providing a pathway for the manufacture of scalable 2D complementary electronics.

papers.title: Surface Equilibration Mechanism Controls the Stability of a Model Co-deposited Glass Mixture of Organic Semiconductors
papers.summary: While previous work has identified the conditions for preparing ultrastable single-component organic glasses by physical vapor deposition (PVD), little is known about the stability of co-deposited mixtures. Here, we prepared binary PVD glasses of organic semiconductors, TPD (N,N-Bis(3-methylphenyl)-N,N-diphenylbenzidine) and m-MTDATA (4,4,4-Tris[phenyl(m-tolyl)amino]triphenylamine), with 50:50 mass concentration over a wide range of substrate temperatures (Tsub). The enthalpy and kinetic stability are evaluated with differential scanning calorimetry and spectroscopic ellipsometry. Binary organic semiconductor glasses with exceptional thermodynamic and kinetic stability comparable to the most stable single-component organic glasses are obtained when deposited at Tsub=0.78-0.90Tg (where Tg is the conventional glass transition temperature). When deposited at 0.94Tg, the enthalpy of m-MTDATA/TPD glass equals that expected for the equilibrium liquid at that temperature. Thus, the surface equilibration mechanism previously advanced for single-component PVD glasses is also applicable for these co-deposited glasses. These results provide an avenue for designing high-performance organic electronic devices.
papers.abstract_cn: 尽管先前的研究已经确定了通过物理气相沉积（PVD）制备超稳定单组分有机玻璃的条件，但对于共沉积混合物的稳定性却知之甚少。在本研究中，我们制备了有机半导体TPD（N,N-双（3-甲基苯基）-N,N-二苯基联苯胺）和m-MTDATA（4,4,4-三[苯基（间甲苯基）氨基]三苯胺）的二元PVD玻璃，二者质量浓度比为50:50，并覆盖较宽范围的衬底温度（Tsub）。我们采用差示扫描量热法和光谱椭偏仪评估其焓和动力学稳定性。当沉积温度为Tsub=0.78-0.90Tg时（其中Tg为常规玻璃化转变温度），所得二元有机半导体玻璃具有出色的热力学稳定性和动力学稳定性，其稳定性水平可与最稳定的单组分有机玻璃相媲美。当沉积温度为0.94Tg时，m-MTDATA/TPD玻璃的焓等于该温度下平衡液体所对应的预期焓。因此，先前针对单组分PVD玻璃提出的表面平衡机制同样适用于这些共沉积玻璃。这些结果为设计高性能有机电子器件提供了一条途径。

papers.title: Biomimetic hierarchical heterogeneity endows layered nanocomposite with excellent mechanical and electrical insulating properties
papers.summary: Aramid-based nanopapers with high mechanical and electrical insulating properties, together with high-temperature stability, are urgently desired for electrical safety but are challenging to be constructed. Notably, biological materials can adopt different nanoscale building blocks and regulate their spatial distribution to construct hierarchical heterostructure for overall performance optimization. Herein, inspired by biological hierarchical heterogeneity, integrating building blocks of two-dimensional rectorite nanosheet (RNS) and one-dimensional aramid nanofiber (ANF), we construct hierarchically heterostructured nanopapers with RNS-enriched bilateral sublayers and the ANF-enriched inner sublayer. The obtained 5-10-5 heterostructured nanopaper with 20-micrometer thickness through systematic regulation exhibits an impressive combination of breakdown strength (171 kilovolts per millimeter), corona resistance (18.3 hours), and mechanical properties, surpassing homostructured RNS-ANF nanopapers. The enhancement efficiency of corona resistance is orders of magnitude higher than that of reported insulating papers. The breakdown strength and corona resistance can be retained at high values in real-time temperature (up to 150°C). These properties make our biomimetic hierarchically heterostructured nanopaper highly competitive for applications.
papers.abstract_cn: 人们迫切需要兼具优异机械性能和电绝缘性能以及高温稳定性的芳纶基纳米纸，以满足电气安全需求，但这类材料难以构筑。值得注意的是，生物材料能够采用不同的纳米尺度构筑单元，并调控其空间分布，从而构建分级异质结构，实现整体性能优化。在此，我们受到生物分级异质性的启发，将二维蛭石纳米片（RNS）和一维芳纶纳米纤维（ANF）两类构筑单元结合起来，构建了具有RNS富集双侧子层和ANF富集内层的分级异质结构纳米纸。通过系统调控获得的20 μm厚5-10-5异质结构纳米纸，在击穿强度（171 kV/mm）、耐电晕性能（18.3 h）和机械性能方面实现了令人瞩目的综合表现，超过了同质结构的RNS-ANF纳米纸。其耐电晕性能的提升效率比已报道的绝缘纸高出数个数量级。在实时温度最高达150°C的条件下，其击穿强度和耐电晕性能仍可保持较高水平。这些性质使我们的仿生分级异质结构纳米纸在相关应用中具有很强的竞争力。

papers.title: Tuning the Optoelectronics of Mixed-Semiconductors through the interplay of Quantum confinement and Stoichiometry Engineering
papers.summary: All-inorganic cesium lead bromide (CsPbBr3) nanocrystals (NCs) have established themselves as an emerging semiconductor for next-generation optoelectronic technologies due to their unique combination of properties, such as near unity photoluminescence quantum yields, narrow color pure emission, and exceptional defect tolerance. Although size-dependent optical signatures of these NCs are well reported, the complexity of mixed ionic-electronic transport remains largely unexplored. In this study, we provide a comprehensive analysis of size-dependent charge transport by decoupling ionic and electronic transport dynamics through carefully designed transient current and space charge limited current measurements. By employing NCs of different sizes ranging from 5.6 nm to 11.3 nm in thin films, we provide a comprehensive understanding of quantum confinement effects and related synthetic chemistry. Contrary to popular beliefs of quantum confinement and band gap broadening, our results demonstrate that the smallest NCs exhibit the most efficient transport characteristics, evidenced by the lowest activation energy (hole activation energy = 78 meV) for hole transport and the highest barrier for vacancy-mediated ion migration (ion activation energy = 370 meV). This work paves a way forward for perovskite-based efficient quantum devices, by demonstrating that moving into a strong quantum confinement regime, a superior charge transport can be facilitated, when supported by carefully tailored stoichiometry.
papers.abstract_cn: 全无机溴化铯铅（CsPbBr3）纳米晶体（NC）凭借其独特的性质组合，包括接近1的光致发光量子产率、窄谱且色纯度高的发射以及出色的缺陷容忍度，已成为下一代光电技术中新兴的半导体材料。尽管关于这类纳米晶体尺寸依赖的光学特征已有大量报道，但混合离子-电子输运的复杂性仍在很大程度上未被探索。在本研究中，我们通过精心设计的瞬态电流测量和空间电荷限制电流测量，将离子输运动力学与电子输运动力学解耦，从而对尺寸依赖的电荷输运进行了全面分析。通过在薄膜中采用尺寸为5.6 nm至11.3 nm的不同纳米晶体，我们全面阐明了量子限域效应及其相关合成化学。与关于量子限域和带隙展宽的普遍认知相反，我们的结果表明，尺寸最小的纳米晶体具有最高效的输运特性；其证据包括空穴输运最低的活化能（空穴活化能=78 meV）以及空位介导离子迁移最高的势垒（离子活化能=370 meV）。本研究表明，在精心调控化学计量比的支持下，进入强量子限域区域能够促进更优异的电荷输运，从而为基于钙钛矿的高效量子器件开辟道路。
